name: Arcanasaurus Venator
description: The arcanasaur venator is the result of magical experimentation on an allosaurus that has resulted in a much smarter and dangerous monstrosity. Enhanced with runecarving, this creature can channel volatile magic to create deadly rays and protective shields.

actions.name: Arcane Ray
actions.description: The Arcanasaur shoots a beam of volatile energy towards a creature, dealing arcane damage. This ability takes 2 power to use. If a creature reaches 0 health as a result of the damage from this ability and their lifeline check is a 3 or less, they are incinerated.

actions.name: Blink
actions.description: After taking the Move Action, the arcanasaur teleports up to 3 units and gains a 1d4 bonus to their next Bite or Ravage Action until the end of their turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The Arcanasaur bites a creature, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target gains one tier of the wounded condition.

actions.name: Ravage
actions.description: The Arcanasaur makes a violent attack against a creature that has the bleeding or wounded condition. On a true hit, the creature must make a resilience check against the total damage dealt after mitigation, or they lose a limb.

actions.name: Razor Claws
actions.description: The Arcanasaur makes a swiping attack with it's razor-like claws, dealing physical damage. The target must also make a resilience check against the total damage dealt after mitigation or gain the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Shell
actions.description: In response to being targeted by a projectile or ray spell, the Arcanasaur creates a protective shell around themselves, gaining a 1d4 bonus to their block check. If the spell misses, the Arcanasaur gains 3 power.

actions.name: Leg Snapper
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the arcanasaur's area of control, it makes an attack against that creature. If the attack hits, the target must make a resilience check against the total damage taken after mitigation or they fall prone and have a movement speed of 0 until the end of their next turn. In the event of a true hit, the target loses one of their legs and gains the bleeding condition.

traits.name: Innate Regeneration
traits.description: The arcanasaur can spend 1 power on the start of it's turn to regenerate 10 health.

traits.name: Lead Aversion
traits.description: When struck with a weapon or ammunition that has been infused with lead, the Arcanasaur must make a resilience check of 9 or higher or be unable to use their Arcane Ray or Blink actions until the end of their next turn.
